selection.ownership: Mailsoftly Inc, San Ramon, California, United States. The reviewed edition is the global API at app.mailsoftly.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Mailsoftly API v3 (host https://app.mailsoftly.com/api/v3, Authorization header is the raw API token, GET /get_contacts, GET /get_contact, GET /get_contact_lists, GET /get_contact_list, POST /authentication), Mailsoftly Inc California identity, and dated incident search (Mailsoftly + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Mailsoftly compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official Mailsoftly API documents HTTPS host https://app.mailsoftly.com/api/v3 and Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY (raw token, not Bearer). GET /get_contacts, GET /get_contact, GET /get_contact_lists, and GET /get_contact_list were confirmed on 2026-09-13. Operator is Mailsoftly Inc (San Ramon, California). Dated incident search found no qualifying current unresolved Mailsoftly compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
research.qualityRationale: Read-only contact and list inventory with documented API-token header auth and HTTP 200 error-envelope fixtures.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /get_contact_lists rather than POST /authentication used by the pinned validator, because healthcheck must be a cheap authenticated read.
Authorization sends the raw API token with no Bearer prefix, matching official curl and pinned requestMailsoftly.
HTTP 200 bodies with a non-empty error string are demoted via http.errors.bodyErrorPaths [error]. status is not used because the success value success is a non-empty string.
Native category is email-marketing. The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes and exact-match search are omitted.
